slug: 2026-01-07 Why Ethiopia, Somalia and Djibouti are starting to matter in digital Africa

facts.fact: TechCabal names the Djibouti Data Centre as a carrier-neutral facility in Djibouti, in a country it calls a Tier 3 carrier-neutral hub; the article gives no date, so its publication date 2026-01-07 is used.

TechCabal says Wingu Group's technology park in Djibouti was recently inaugurated and counts it among the carrier-neutral facilities; no opening date is given, so the publication date 2026-01-07 is used.

note: Tier 3 is asserted by the article for the country's hub via these facilities, not by an operator or certifier per facility, so no tier3 fact.
